call_points.text: Effective tax rate for FY27 guided at 10%-12% on a consolidated basis.
Gross margin rose to 24.65%, up 329 bps YoY and 542 bps QoQ, on better procurement and realisation.
Strategic inventory bought ahead of memory price rises helped gross margin and sales.
Other expenses rose about 68% YoY, which management linked to incentivisation for better realisation and sales.
Q1 volumes: 1,08,000 laptops and 42,000 desktops and others; laptops were 81% of revenue.
Revenue split: 36% India, 12% Middle East, 47% US and Europe, 5% others.
Management declined to give inventory-days, receivable-days or cash-conversion targets, citing the evolving situation.
Headcount rose to 2,420 as of June 2026 from 2,148.
FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 166 bps over FY25 on strong execution and industry tailwinds.
Q4 PAT nearly tripled YoY alongside revenue growth of about 43%.
ROE moderated to 26.8% at March 31, 2026 from 35%, mainly on the larger post-IPO equity base.
Management cites accelerating AI adoption and supply constraints in new computing hardware driving demand for refurbished enterprise devices.
Refurbishment facilities operate across India, the UAE and the USA, supporting the Electronics Bazaar brand.
No numeric FY27 revenue or margin target is given; management only says it is confident of sustaining growth momentum.

operating_notes.text: Company has a distribution network of over 4,700 touchpoints across 44 countries in refurbished ICT devices.
FY26 operating cash flow was -₹215.3 Cr while inventories rose to ₹743.11 Cr and trade receivables to ₹206.85 Cr at 31 March 2026.
FY26 financing cash flow was ₹351.27 Cr, including ₹400 Cr from issue of share capital.
FY26 gross margin was 20.1%, up 225 bps from 17.9% in FY25, with Q4 FY26 gross margin at 19.2%.
Refurbishment facilities operate across India, the UAE and the USA under the Electronics Bazaar brand.
ROE was 26.8% at March 31, 2026, down from 35% a year earlier on the larger post-IPO equity base.
Company refurbished nearly 7.27 lakh devices in FY26.
Full year FY26 refurbishment volume was about 7,27,000 units, with blending ASP at ₹26,000.
Q1FY27 volumes were 1,08,000 laptops and 42,000 desktops and others, with laptops at 81% of revenue.
Laptop ASP was ₹30,763 in Q1FY27 versus ₹27,500 a year ago; desktop and others ASP was about ₹19,300 versus about ₹17,500.
Memory prices rose 5%-10% in the quarter, with 8GB DDR5 at $126 and 16GB DDR5 at $231 as of June 30, 2026.
Electronics Bazaar FZC leased 2,238.77 sq mtrs at SAIF Zone, UAE for 25 years from 24 September 2026 to expand regional refurbishing capacity.
